decisions.reason: Cites 42 session.events reads in plugin-source-excerpt.js, crash-stack iteration failure in prepareReplayEvents, changelog removal at 0.1.2-alpha.4 replaced by seq/eventAt()/snapshotEvents(); explains undefined -> not-iterable during apply().
Explains alpha.5 satisfies ^0.1.2-alpha.2 (>=0.1.2-alpha.2 <0.2.0-0) and npm only compares version strings, never loads code or inspects APIs; peer range is publisher claim, not tested evidence.
Multiple genuinely distinct classes: removed/renamed API, changed contract/signature (SessionSeq branding), return-shape change, lifecycle/init-contract change, config/event drift, transitive drift.

Requires testing actual target versions (CI boot against newest in range, both ends), plus policy: narrow peer range to exclude alpha.4+ or implement capability-detection guard with correct old/new paths; explains engines cannot encode API facts.

Concrete pre-install procedure: expand peer range, read changelog for removals in window, npm pack + grep plugin source for session.events (42 hits), cross-check typings; explicitly tied to this Session.events incident; warns npm ls green is insufficient.

caps.reason: Report affirms peer satisfaction is only arithmetic and does not prove runtime compatibility; removal acknowledged.
